hero.title: Puzzles & books that take kids places.
hero.subtitle: Kaia & Tata Publishing makes coloring books, custom stories, and playful puzzles for young explorers — and helps new authors get published.

adventure.title: The Kaia Adventure Series
adventure.body: Follow Kaia as she goes places — through mangrove swamps, past curious alligators and wading herons. Big, bold line art made for little hands and giant imaginations.
adventure.alt: Kaia Goes Places — coloring book cover with a young explorer, an alligator and a heron

custom.title: Custom Coloring Books
custom.body: Put your child at the center of the story. We craft personalized coloring books — riding elephants, roaming jungles, wherever their adventure leads.
custom.alt: Custom coloring book page of a child riding a decorated elephant

puzzles.title: Puzzles for Kids
puzzles.body: Find the differences, trace the path, connect the dots, hunt for words, and colour by number. Screen-free fun that builds focus, patience, and a love of solving.
puzzles.alt: Puzzles for kids — find the differences, trace the path, connect the dots, word search and colour by number

publishing.title: Publishing Opportunities
publishing.body: Have a story or activity book in you? Bring it to our press. We help authors and illustrators turn manuscripts into published books for kids everywhere.
publishing.alt: Publishing opportunities — a vintage printing press by a river

join.title: Join the adventure
join.body: New books, puzzles, and publishing news — straight to your inbox.
